pwa_banner.title: 📲 Install App on your phone
pwa_banner.description: Hello works like a native app! Install on your phone to receive doorbell notifications and answer visitors anywhere.

step1.title: 1. Space Management
step1.description: The first step is defining where people will arrive. Create your main Property, then add different Access Units (e.g. Main Door, Garage Gate, Annex).
step1.tip: You can click the "Pencil" button next to the name of spaces in Tables to edit their name at any time.

step2.title: 2. Sharing Control
step2.description: You don't have to manage access alone. Go to Saved People to add family or staff. You can now generate an Invite Link (Token) and send it via message or email — hassle-free!
step2.tip: Sharing via link is instant. The new member just needs to open the URL and create their password to enter.

step3.title: 3. Generating Magic Keys (QR)
step3.description: Inside your Units pages, click a space and press generate Invite. Name the Visitor and print or send them the created QR Code. This is what the person scans at the door to announce themselves.

step4.title: 4. Answering the Door (Chat and Video)
step4.description: When a visitor rings the bell, they appear in your People at the Door list. The interface is fluid and operates in real-time.
step4.bullet1: Open the Chat to interact instantly with the visitor.
step4.bullet2: Click on 🎥 Call to start the Minimalist HD Video Call.
step4.bullet3: The video interface is clean: it focuses only on the image and the hang-up button.
step4.bullet4: Finish by clicking Approve or Reject Access.

step5.title: 5. Mobile App (PWA)
step5.description: HELLO is a native app in disguise. No App Store needed.
step5.bullet1: Open the link of this panel in your phone browser and tap Add to home screen.
step5.bullet3: Whenever the door is activated in the street, the App automatically turns on the screen, vibrates and sounds an alert on your phone!

step6.title: 6. The Visitor's Perspective
step6.description: While you are inside, it matters to know what is happening in the street.
step6.bullet1: No Apps: The visitor just scans the QR you printed (iOS/Android).
step6.bullet2: Takes a selfie and enters the digital Waiting Room.
step6.bullet3: If you are late, they have a 🔔 Ring again button (10 s cooldown) that resends the alert to your phone.
